text:
maria: FYI — postmortem follow-up for the late-night OOM on kv-shard-47. We need a compact action list: who owns deep profiling, who owns short-term mitigations, and who owns alerting/long-term GC experiments.

tom: I'll grab the live heap sampling. Plan: run heaptrack on a pinned canary, capture 30m of traffic, then collect gcore if we see steady growth. I'll also drop jemalloc stats periodically. Owner: tom. ETA: Mon AM.

sasha: I'll try a conservative jemalloc tuning + slab compaction toggle on one canary host. Small risk but avoids full rollback if it regresses. Will also enable `oom-sentinel` (our script) to capture kernel OOM logs. Owner: sasha. ETA: today 18:00.

leo: On routing: I can add a temporary traffic split to avoid hot prefixes hitting shard-47 while we test. 20% reroute for 2h windows, revert if P75 latency > baseline+30ms. Owner: leo. ETA: 2h.

ops-bot: ops-bot: canary change queued: kv/jemalloc-compaction-toggle by @sasha at 2025-04-21T02:10:00Z (canary 5%).

tom: Quick note from first 10m heaptrack: many small allocations pinned in `prefetch_thread` and persistent string fragments from the rewrite path. Not classic leak pattern; looks like churn + high fragmentation. Will attach flamegraphs.

maria: Good detail. Add a mid-term experiment: scheduled slab compaction run during low traffic + a GC tuning pass (reduce arena fragmentation, bump purge interval). Track before/after residency heatmap.

sasha: If compaction helps, we should automate a weekly compaction during maintenance windows. But first get data: compaction impact on 95th latency and eviction churn.

leo: Monitoring changes: add a short-lived synthetic that repeatedly writes long prefixes to shard-47 canary to reproduce fragmentation faster. Also add alert: sudden step in fragmentation delta >20% in 5m. Owner: leo. ETA: today 16:00.

tom: Uploading artifacts to: https://internal.redwood/gists/kv/1781234567-profiles. Will also add allocation stacks (top 50) as text.

maria: Action roll-up: tom 1 profiling + artifacts (Mon AM); sasha 1 jemalloc compaction toggle + oom-sentinel (canary today); leo 1 traffic split + synthetic + alerts (today); maria 1 postmortem doc + schedule GC experiment (Wed). If anyone hits blockers post here. :eyes:
